_note: Timings (seconds) measured from VoiceOver.mp3 with FFmpeg silencedetect. Scene cuts sit inside the pauses between voice-over paragraphs. Captions follow the spoken phrases; numbers are written as digits for reading.

captions.text:
Repeated API reads send the same request
back to the database,
Even when the answer is unchanged,

each repeat adds delay and keeps the
database doing work again.
A cache keeps a copy near the API.

A miss fetches from the database
and fills the cache;
a hit returns that copy directly.

repeat reads take a shorter route without
another database round trip.

Measure your own workload before
promising any improvement.
